en: Hold hands with someone here and run a lap around the room while singing "你还要我怎样".
zh: 找一个在场的人和你手拉手绕场跑一圈，边跑边唱《你还要我怎样》。

en: Face-to-face with a same-gender player, hold a pen between your faces for 10 seconds.
zh: 找一个在场的同性，脸对脸夹着一支笔坚持10秒。

en: Sing one verse of a worship song, solo.
zh: 独唱一段敬拜诗歌。

en: Show the group the most recent photo in your camera roll (skip if truly private).
zh: 给大家看你相册里最新的一张照片（太私密可跳过）。

en: Imitate how your fellowship leader opens the meeting.
zh: 模仿团契带领人开场的样子。

en: Speak only in your hometown dialect or accent for the next two rounds.
zh: 接下来两轮只能用家乡话说话。

en: Do an animal impression until someone guesses the animal.
zh: 模仿一种动物，直到有人猜出来。

en: You may only sing, not speak, until your next turn.
zh: 到你下一轮之前，只能用唱的说话。

en: Read your most recent sent message in the most dramatic, romantic voice.
zh: 用最深情的语气朗读你最近发出的一条消息。

en: Imitate someone in this room — mannerisms and catchphrases — until people guess who.
zh: 模仿在场一个人的标志性动作和口头禅，直到大家猜出是谁。

en: Voice-message a friend you haven't talked to in a month: "I'm thankful for you."
zh: 给一个月没联系的朋友发语音：“我很感恩认识你。”

en: Recite any Bible verse from memory within 10 seconds — fail and you draw another dare.
zh: 10秒内背出一节圣经经文，失败就再抽一张大冒险。

en: Let the group look at your most-used emojis and analyze your personality.
zh: 让大家看你最常用的表情符号，并解读你的性格。

en: Give every person in the room a one-sentence compliment.
zh: 用一句话夸奖在场的每一个人。

en: Do 10 push-ups; before each one, name something you're thankful for.
zh: 做10个俯卧撑，每做一个之前说一件感恩的事。

en: Call a parent on speaker and tell them you love them.
zh: 给爸妈打电话（开免提）说“我爱你”。

en: Sit back-to-back with someone and stand up together without using your hands.
zh: 和在场一个人背靠背坐下，不用手一起站起来。

en: Stare into someone's eyes for 30 seconds — whoever laughs first draws another dare.
zh: 和一个人对视30秒，谁先笑谁再抽一张大冒险。

en: Spell your name with your hips.
zh: 用屁股扭出你的名字。

en: Let the person on your left pose you for a photo — they keep it.
zh: 让你左边的人给你摆一个拍照姿势，照片归ta保存。

en: Arm-wrestle anyone here; the loser does 5 squats.
zh: 和在场任何一人比腕力，输的做5个深蹲。

en: Close your eyes and let another player feed you a snack — guess what it is.
zh: 闭上眼睛，让一个人喂你吃一样零食，猜出是什么。

en: Draw a portrait of someone here with your non-dominant hand in 30 seconds — they keep it.
zh: 用非惯用手30秒画出在场一个人的肖像，本人保留。

en: Hold hands with a same-gender friend, gaze into their eyes, and say "认识你真好" without laughing.
zh: 和一位同性十指相扣深情对望，说“认识你真好”，不许笑。

en: Pray out loud for the person across from you, right now, by name.
zh: 现在就为你对面的人开口祷告，要提名。

en: Ask the group "what's one thing I could grow in?" — listen without defending yourself.
zh: 问大家：“你觉得我有什么可以成长的地方？”只能听，不能辩解。

en: Text a friend who doesn't come to church: "Thought of you at fellowship tonight — want to come with me Sunday?"
zh: 给一位不来教会的朋友发：“今晚在团契想到你了，周日要不要一起来？”

en: Give a 30-second improvised sermon on a random object the group picks.
zh: 用大家随手指定的一个物品，即兴讲道30秒。

en: Call the 5th contact in your phone and say: "I drew a dare card and it says I must thank you for being in my life."
zh: 打给通讯录里第5个人说：“我抽到大冒险，要谢谢你出现在我的生命里。”

en: Let the group pick a pose; hold it until the next card is drawn.
zh: 让大家给你指定一个姿势，保持不动直到下一张卡被抽出。

en: Act out a Bible character's entrance until people guess who.
zh: 模仿一位圣经人物出场，直到大家猜出是谁。

en: Show the group your best party trick — anything counts.
zh: 给大家表演你最拿手的看家本领，什么都行。

en: Re-enter the room in slow motion, with your own sound effects.
zh: 用慢动作重现你今天进门的样子，自己配音效。

en: Serenade a pillow with the chorus of any love song.
zh: 抱着一个抱枕，深情演唱一首歌的副歌。

en: Play rock-paper-scissors with anyone — the loser performs an animal sound chosen by the winner.
zh: 和在场一人玩石头剪刀布，输的人学赢家指定的动物叫。

en: Let the group give you three random words; improvise a 30-second story using all of them.
zh: 让大家出三个词，用它们即兴编一段30秒的小故事。

en: Broadcast “tonight's fellowship news” in a formal news-anchor voice.
zh: 用新闻主播腔播报“今晚团契大事件”。

en: Let the person on your right restyle your hair for 10 seconds; keep it for 30 minutes.
zh: 让右边的人给你抓10秒头发，造型保持30分钟。

en: Swap one wearable item (jacket, glasses, watch) with someone until the game ends.
zh: 和在场一人交换一件随身物品（外套、眼镜、手表），直到游戏结束。

en: Answer the next question while holding a squat.
zh: 深蹲姿势保持不动，回答下一个问题。

en: Give a formal 30-second welcome speech honoring the newest member of the fellowship.
zh: 给最新加入团契的人做一个正式的30秒欢迎致辞。

en: Let someone write one sentence on your arm in washable pen — keep it until tonight ends.
zh: 让在场一人用水性笔在你手臂上写一句话，保留到今晚结束。

en: Post a single “。” in the fellowship group chat and don't explain for 10 minutes.
zh: 在团契群里只发一个“。”，十分钟内不许解释。

en: For your next two turns, everything you say must rhyme.
zh: 接下来两轮，你说的每句话都必须押韵。

en: Act out yourself being woken up by your alarm on a Monday morning.
zh: 表演“周一早上被闹钟叫醒的你”。

en: Read a nursery rhyme with a completely serious face — no smiling allowed.
zh: 用最严肃的表情念一段儿歌，不许笑。

en: Do a runway walk around the room while everyone hums the background music.
zh: 现场走秀绕场一圈，BGM由大家现场哼。

en: Imitate the sound of a musical instrument until someone guesses it.
zh: 模仿一种乐器的声音，直到有人猜出来。

en: Name 10 fruits within 10 seconds — fail and draw another dare.
zh: 10秒内说出10种水果，失败再抽一张大冒险。

en: Write “我爱我们团契” with your non-dominant hand and let everyone inspect it.
zh: 用非惯用手写“我爱我们团契”，给大家检查。

en: Act out “pretending to be on an important call in an elevator with no signal”.
zh: 表演“电梯里没信号却要假装通话很忙”。

en: For one round, you may only reply to people using song lyrics.
zh: 接下来一轮，别人对你说什么，你都只能用歌词回答。

en: Mirror challenge: face a partner and copy their every move for 30 seconds without laughing.
zh: 双人镜子挑战：面对面，对方做什么你同步模仿30秒，不许笑。

en: Blindfolded, identify three objects the group places in your hands.
zh: 蒙上眼睛，摸出大家放到你手里的三样东西。

en: High-note challenge: sing the last line of 青藏高原 — or the highest note of any song.
zh: 高音挑战：唱《青藏高原》最后一句，或任何歌的最高音。

en: Predictive-text challenge: type “我”, tap the first suggestion 10 times, and read the sentence aloud.
zh: 输入法联想挑战：打一个“我”，连点联想词10次，把生成的句子读出来。

en: Bible-story charades: the person on your right acts one out silently; guess it within 30 seconds.
zh: 圣经比划猜：右边的人无声比划一个圣经故事，你30秒内猜出。

en: Sing “Hallelujah” three times in vocal fry or full opera voice.
zh: 用气泡音或美声唱三遍“哈利路亚”。

en: Perform a nursery rhyme chosen by the group in rock or opera style.
zh: 用摇滚或歌剧腔演唱一首大家选的儿歌。

en: Mind-meld: you and a partner shout “the world's tastiest food” at the same time — pass when you match; each miss costs you both 5 squats (max 3 tries).
zh: 和对面的人同时喊“最好吃的食物”，喊到同一样才过关，不同则各做5个深蹲（最多三轮）。

en: Let the group restyle you with anything on hand (jackets, glasses, hair ties) — keep the look for two rounds.
zh: 让大家用手边任何东西给你凹一个新造型，保持两轮。

en: Show everyone today's real screen time (or step count).
zh: 把你的屏幕使用时间或微信步数打开，给大家看今天的真实数据。

en: Invent a nickname for every person in the room, on the spot, until everyone approves.
zh: 现场给在场每个人各编一个外号，大家满意才过关。

en: Compose and recite a two-line acrostic poem starting with someone's name.
zh: 用在场一个人的名字开头，现场作一首两句“藏头诗”并朗读。

en: Call a good friend and say, dead serious: “I have a secret — I'm actually a mermaid.” Hold for 10 seconds before explaining.
zh: 打电话给好朋友，认真地说“我告诉你一个秘密：其实我是一条美人鱼”，撑10秒再解释。

en: Immunity flip: everyone asks you one question and you must answer honestly (you may skip one).
zh: 豁免翻转：在场每人向你提一个问题，必须诚实回答（可跳过一个）。

en: Raise one hand, shout “I'm Superman and I'm going home!”, and do a flying lap around the room.
zh: 举手大喊“我是超人，我要回家了！”然后摆飞行姿势绕场一圈。

en: Recite the Lord's Prayer; every stumble costs one jumping jack before continuing.
zh: 背诵主祷文，卡住一次做一个开合跳再继续。

en: Improvise and perform a 15-second personal theme song for the person on your left.
zh: 给左边的人即兴创作并演唱15秒“专属主题曲”。

en: Group selfie with you making the most exaggerated face up front — post it to the fellowship group chat.
zh: 全组自拍，你在最前面摆最夸张的表情，照片发到团契群。

en: Hold a pen between your upper lip and nose while giving a full self-introduction — don't drop it.
zh: 把一支笔夹在嘴唇和鼻子之间，完整说完一段自我介绍，笔不能掉。

en: Imitate your favorite influencer's signature opening until people guess who it is.
zh: 学你最喜欢的网红/博主的经典开场，让大家猜是谁。

en: Give a 30-second award acceptance speech thanking everyone here — for completely absurd reasons (“thank you XX for that half bottle of water three months ago”).
zh: 发表30秒获奖感言，感谢在场每一个人，但理由必须离谱（“感谢XX三个月前借我的那半瓶水，没有他就没有今天的我”）。

en: Eyes closed, name the color of everyone's outfit today.
zh: 闭上眼睛，凭记忆说出在场每个人今天衣服的颜色。

en: Show everyone your phone wallpaper and tell its story.
zh: 给大家看你的手机壁纸，并讲讲它的故事。

en: In your softest, sweetest voice, deliver a long menacing speech: “I'll count to three — snatch my snacks again and I'll kick you out of the group chat, then tie your shoelaces together so you trip with every step~”
zh: 用最温柔的奶音完整说完这段狠话：“我数到三，你再抢我零食，我就把你从群里踢出去，再把你的鞋带系在一起，让你走一步摔一步哦~”

en: Everyone types one word into your phone; read the resulting sentence aloud with deep emotion.
zh: 在场每人往你手机里打一个词，连成的句子你必须深情朗读。

en: Call a friend, sing to them for 10 seconds, say “thanks for listening”, and hang up.
zh: 打电话给朋友清唱10秒，唱完只说“谢谢收听”就挂。

en: Perform a famous drama scene in Sichuanese, Northeastern dialect, or Cantonese — pick one: 还珠格格 “山无棱，天地合”, 情深深雨濛濛 “你无情你残酷你无理取闹”, or 甄嬛传 “臣妾做不到啊” — and draft a scene partner.
zh: 用四川话、东北话或粤语演一段知名片段（三选一：还珠格格“山无棱，天地合，才敢与君绝”、情深深雨濛濛“你无情你残酷你无理取闹”、甄嬛传“臣妾做不到啊”），并抽一人配戏。

en: Name 10 people from the Bible within 30 seconds.
zh: 30秒内说出圣经里10个人名，停顿不能超过3秒。

en: Let someone draw a small doodle on your face with a washable pen — keep it until the game ends.
zh: 让大家用可洗的笔在你脸上画一样小东西，保留到游戏结束。

en: Call a friend and let them decide whether your next card is Truth or Dare — then obey.
zh: 打电话给一个朋友，让ta替你决定下一张抽真心话还是大冒险，并照做。

en: Give a sharp fashion review of two people's outfits here — no talking back allowed.
zh: 锐评在场两个人的今日穿搭，被锐评者不许反驳。

en: Everyone roasts one small habit of yours; you may only reply “thanks for the feedback”.
zh: 在场每人轮流吐槽你一个小习惯，你只能回答“谢谢指教”。

en: Show everyone who your pinned chats are (contents may be covered).
zh: 给大家看你微信的置顶聊天都是谁（内容可以遮住）。

en: The person on your left picks any photo from your camera roll; tell its full story.
zh: 让左边的人从你相册随便挑一张照片，你讲出它的完整故事。

en: Show the last three messages between you and your mom or dad (you may skip one).
zh: 公开你和爸/妈最近的三条聊天记录（可跳过一条）。

en: Reveal the top five items in your shopping cart or wishlist and accept the group's review.
zh: 公开你的购物车/收藏夹前五件商品，接受全场锐评。

en: Reveal your five most recent search records (you may skip one).
zh: 公开你最近的五条搜索记录（可跳过一条）。

en: Screenshot today's step count and post it to the group chat captioned “a disciplined day”.
zh: 把今天的步数截图发到团契群，配文“自律的一天”。

en: Rate everyone's outfit today from 1 to 10, out loud.
zh: 给在场每个人的今日穿搭打1-10分，当众宣布。

en: Describe your journey to fellowship today in Classical Chinese.
zh: 用文言文描述你今天来团契的路程。

en: Everyone votes with eyes closed for “who's holding back the most tonight” — the winner does 5 squats with you.
zh: 全场闭眼投票“今晚谁最放不开”，得票最多的人和你一起做5个深蹲。

en: Everyone delivers one cheesy pickup line to you; keep a straight face — each laugh costs one squat.
zh: 在场每人对你说一句土味情话，你必须面无表情听完，笑一次做一个深蹲。

en: Spend one minute formally proposing a ridiculous “next week's fellowship activity”, then the group votes by show of hands.
zh: 用一分钟正式提案一个离谱的“下周团契活动”，大家举手表决。

en: Dig up the very first thing you ever bookmarked or saved, and show everyone.
zh: 翻出你“收藏”里最早收藏的那一条内容，给大家看看当年的你。

en: Send the person on your right a real 60-second voice message of elder-style life advice — no pausing allowed.
zh: 给右边的人发一条真的60秒语音，内容是长辈风格的“人生建议”，中途不能停顿。

en: Pick an opposite-gender player and hold deep, soulful eye contact for 15 seconds.
zh: 选一位在场的异性，深情对视15秒。

en: Do 10 push-ups, saying “我好菜” (“I'm so weak”) out loud with each one.
zh: 做10个俯卧撑，边做边说“我好菜”。

en: Let the person on your right braid or style your hair.
zh: 让右边的人给你编一个辫子，或者整理发型。

en: Rest your head on a same-gender player's lap for 10 seconds while acting like you're thoroughly enjoying it.
zh: 头枕在一位同性的腿上10秒，同时演出你很享受的样子。

en: Pick an opposite-gender player and whisper a secret in their ear.
zh: 选在场一位异性，跟ta说一句悄悄话。

en: Have a same-gender player carry you princess-style and take a selfie together.
zh: 找在场一位同性公主抱你，并自拍一张。

en: Pick a same-gender player and say “你保护世界，而我，保护你～” in three different tones.
zh: 选在场一位同性，用三种不同的语气对ta说“你保护世界，而我，保护你～”。
